changeSet.author: OpenELIS
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case DROP CONSTRAINT micro_case_stage_chk; ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case ADD CONSTRAINT micro_case_stage_chk CHECK (stage IN ('RECEIVED', 'SETUP_RECORDED', 'INCUBATING', 'POSITIVE_SIGNAL', 'GROWTH_DETECTED', 'NO_GROWTH_READY', 'IDENTIFICATION', 'AST_READY', 'AST_IN_PROGRESS', 'REVIEW_READY', 'PRELIM_RELEASED', 'FINAL_RELEASED', 'AMENDED', 'REJECTED', 'LOST_SPECIMEN', 'LOST_SPECIMEN_POSITIVE', 'CANCELLED'))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_micro_request_test ON clinlims.micro_case_requested_test (request_id, test_id) WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL

ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case_requested_test ADD CONSTRAINT ck_micro_request_cancellation CHECK ((cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NULL) OR (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancelled_by)) > 0))
ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case_requested_test ADD CONSTRAINT ck_micro_request_role CHECK (case_role IN ('CULTURE','DIRECT','CASE') AND (NOT collected_in_sets OR case_role='CULTURE'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case DROP CONSTRAINT micro_case_stage_chk; ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case ADD CONSTRAINT micro_case_stage_chk CHECK (stage IN ('RECEIVED', 'SETUP_RECORDED', 'INCUBATING', 'POSITIVE_SIGNAL', 'GROWTH_DETECTED', 'NO_GROWTH_READY', 'IDENTIFICATION', 'AST_READY', 'AST_IN_PROGRESS', 'REVIEW_READY', 'PRELIM_RELEASED', 'FINAL_RELEASED', 'AMENDED', 'REJECTED', 'LOST_SPECIMEN', 'LOST_SPECIMEN_POSITIVE'))
